title: 第13章 利益冲突第14章 灵活战斗
content_zh:
第13章利益冲突
来到新地方，和同屋中的人交谈了一番，林浩差不多和这些人混了个脸熟。
接下来，木屋内鸦雀无声，十个杂役弟子，都开始修炼。
作为杂役弟子，他们如果三年内，没有成为外门弟子，就不得不离开山门，前往玄岳宗掌握的世俗城市做事。
那里灵气稀薄，比起玄岳宗所在的山脉灵气，差之千里。
若是不能晋升外门弟子离开玄岳宗，那意味着仙路就此断绝。
所以，这三年中每时每刻对杂役弟子们来说，都非常重要，对修炼一事不敢懈怠。
翌日，旭日东升。
林浩结束修炼，离开木屋跟着姜胜他们，前往挖矿的地方，老人杂役区的矿洞地下空间，可比他之前所待的地方大得多。
半刻钟时间后……。
木屋十人，来到目的地。
“锵锵！
丁丁！”
周围已经有不少杂役弟子，挥动着十字镐开始挖矿。
“林师弟，这里便是属于我们的地盘。”
领头的姜胜给他介绍道。
“嗯，姜师兄我明白了。”
林浩目光快速扫过，发现属于他们十人的区域，还挺大的，他估摸了一下，差不多有五十多丈的区域。
“开始干活吧！”
他们分散开来，拿着十字镐对着坚硬的地面，挖了起来。

时间流逝，转眼一个时辰过去。
林浩发现这个矿洞土石质地更硬，但灵铁的数量，明显比在他之前新人区的那个矿洞多了许多。
他调用炼气二重的灵气，加持在双手，卖力挖矿，才过去一个时辰，就挖出了九斤灵铁。
“林师弟，你这么厉害！
挖矿如此之快。”
姜胜看他不断挥动挖矿工具，短短时间，挖出的灵铁，都快赶上他们这些炼气二重的矿区老人了，不由有些惊讶。
“我是新人，怕给大家拖后腿，所以不得不全力以赴，才挖出这么多矿。”
林浩憨厚的笑了笑。
他作为五行灵根灵气远比同境界的人雄厚，一个时辰，挖出九斤灵矿，已经是藏拙了，如果真的全力以赴，一个时辰挖出十多斤灵矿完全没问题。
“原来如此，林师弟不用那么急，别把自己累着了，干活得循序渐进。”
姜胜好心的开口劝道。
“嗯，姜师兄，我晓得了。”
林浩点头，初步和这姜胜接触下来，他感觉姜胜为人和蔼，品性似乎不错。
不像之前他在新人区遇到的那严衡，面目可恶，对人苛刻残暴。
时间慢慢流逝，直到中午。
林浩他们辛苦一早上，十个人总共挖出了一百七十多斤灵铁。
他们修为达到炼气二重境界的四人，每人差不多挖出了二十多斤，加起来便有九十多斤。
而其他境界还在炼气一重的六人，因为修炼时间都在一年左右，体内灵气比新人区的强了不少，他们挖矿的速度比不上炼气二重，但也不是太慢。
content_en:
Chapter 13 Conflict of Interest
When he came to the new place, he talked with the people in the same room. Lin Hao almost became familiar with these people.
Next, there was silence in the wooden house, and the ten handyman disciples all began to practice.
As servant disciples, if they do not become outer disciples within three years, they will have to leave the mountain gate and go to work in the secular city controlled by the Xuanyue Sect.
The spiritual energy there is thin, and it is thousands of miles away from the spiritual energy of the mountains where Xuanyue Sect is located.
If he cannot be promoted to an outer disciple and leaves the Xuanyue Sect, it means that the path to immortality will be cut off.
Therefore, every moment during these three years is very important to the handyman disciples, and they dare not slack off in their cultivation.
The next day, the sun rises in the east.
Lin Hao finished his training and left the wooden house to follow Jiang Sheng and the others to the mining place. The underground space of the mine in the old man's handyman area was much larger than the place where he had been before.
Half a quarter of an hour later….
Ten people in the wooden house arrived at their destination.
“Qiang Qiang!
Tintin! "
There were already many handyman disciples around, waving pickaxes and starting to dig.
"Junior Brother Lin, this is our territory."
Jiang Sheng, the leader, introduced him.
"Yes, Senior Brother Jiang, I understand."
Lin Hao quickly scanned the area and found that the area belonging to the ten of them was quite large. He estimated that it was almost fifty feet in area.
"Let's get to work!"
They spread out, holding pickaxes against the hard ground, and started digging.
Time passed, and an hour passed in the blink of an eye.
Lin Hao found that the earth and stone in this mine were harder, but the amount of spiritual iron was obviously much greater than in the mine in the newcomer area before him.
He summoned the spiritual energy from the second level of Qi Refining, blessed it in his hands, and dug hard. In just one hour, he dug out nine kilograms of spiritual iron.
"Junior brother Lin, you are so powerful!
Mining is so fast. "
Jiang Sheng couldn't help but be a little surprised when he saw that he kept waving the mining tools. In a short period of time, the amount of spiritual iron he dug out was almost as much as the old people from the mining area who were at the second level of Qi Refining.
"I am a newcomer and I am afraid of holding back everyone, so I have to go all out to dig out so many mines."
Lin Hao smiled honestly.
As the Five Elements Spiritual Root, his spiritual energy is far stronger than that of people in the same realm. He can dig out nine kilograms of spiritual minerals in one hour, which is already too much. If he really goes all out, he can dig out more than ten kilograms of spiritual minerals in one hour.
"I see, Junior Brother Lin, don't be in such a hurry, don't tire yourself out, work step by step."
Jiang Sheng advised kindly.
"Yes, Senior Brother Jiang, I understand."
Lin Hao nodded and made initial contact with Jiang Sheng. He felt that Jiang Sheng was kind and had good character.
Unlike the Yan Heng he met in the rookie area before, he was hateful and harsh and cruel to others.
Time passed slowly until noon.
Lin Hao and the others worked hard all morning, and the ten of them dug out a total of more than 170 kilograms of spiritual iron.
The four of them, who had reached the second level of Qi refining, each dug out more than twenty kilograms, and the total amount was more than ninety kilograms.
As for the other six people who are still at the first level of Qi Refining, because they have been practicing for about a year, the spiritual energy in their bodies is much stronger than that of the newcomers. Their mining speed is not as fast as that of the second level of Qi Refining, but it is not too slow.
